description: Look up the name, symbol, decimals and total supply of an ERC-20 token contract on HyperEVM, live from the contract. Use to identify an unknown token address or to format raw amounts; for a holder's balance use hyperevm_token_balance. Input is a ticker (USDC, WETH…) or the token's 0x contract address; an address that is not an ERC-20 contract returns 422, uncharged. Example: token=0xb88339CB7199b77E23DB6E890353E22632Ba630f. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

token.description: Token: a ticker such as USDC or WETH, or the 0x ERC-20 contract address
